findings.claim: from about 2,500 people up the 0.1% bar needs a rate of about 0.0033–0.0035, i.e. stability of about 0.8 or more
findings.evidence: wp/populationDynamics.js:381-383: delta = round(expectation), dropped when below max(2, round(pop×0.001)). Because the bar is rounded, the needed rate oscillates. At 3,499 people the bar is 3 and needs expectation ≥ 2.5, i.e. rate ≥ 0.00248 (RR stability ≈ 0.67). Only large places tend to 0.00348 (stability ≈ 0.80).
findings.fix: 'needs a rate between about 0.0025 and 0.0035 (rounding makes it oscillate, settling toward 0.0035 as places grow), i.e. RR stability of roughly 0.67–0.80'.

findings.claim: [INFERRED] a steading reaches 401 in roughly 40–70 weeks if backing holds
findings.evidence: Iterating wp/settlementLifecycleKernel.js:958 (max(1, round(pop×(0.02+0.05×backing)))) from 16–31 founders (:200-201, :419) gives 78 weeks for 16 founders at backing 0.45, 63 for 31 at 0.45, 49 for 16 at 1.0 and 39 for 31 at 1.0.
findings.fix: 'roughly 40–80 weeks (39 for 31 founders at full backing, 78 for 16 founders at the 0.45 floor)'.
